Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files except whitelisted security products
Uses Windows Management Interface (WMI) to query FirewallProduct, AntiVirusProduct, and AntiSpywareProduct classes and whitelist them
Leaves security products operational by not encrypting their files
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with locally-installed security products (firewalls, antivirus, antispyware)
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of whitelisted security products in FirewallProduct, AntiVirusProduct, AntiSpywareProduct classes via WMI queries
